Hi María (and Rafael),

Thanks for sending the tax certificate — that helps. Short answers first, then a sample invoice template and next steps.

1) VAT (IVA) treatment
- Redwood’s AP policy for Chile: we prefer suppliers to issue invoices gross with IVA shown if local tax law requires it. However, for many digital/technical services there is an option for reverse-charge/self-assessment.
- For HorizonLabs specifically, we’ll ask Tax to confirm whether Redwood will self-assess. In the meantime, please prepare two invoice variants: one with IVA line (19%) and one without IVA (net). We will confirm which to use before payment.

2) PO fields and format
- PO number: RDW-YYYY-##### (e.g., RDW-2027-00421) — mandatory on the invoice
- Required invoice fields: vendor legal name, VAT/Tax ID (RUT for Chile), billing address, invoice date, PO number, description of services, quantity/period, unit price, currency, total net, IVA amount (if applicable), bank details for wire transfer (SWIFT/IBAN if USD), and Redwood tax contact: tax-compliance@redwood.com
- Optional: cost center (format CC-1234) — include if your AR needs to map to an internal Redwood project.

3) Currency and payment
- Preferred currency: USD. We can accept CLP if that’s HLTech's standard, but please indicate whether your bank charges FX fees and which currency you prefer on the invoice.

4) Tax representative and documentation
- If HorizonLabs has a Chilean tax representative or agent for inbound VAT matters, please include their contact. If not, Redwood’s tax team may request additional evidence for reverse-charge treatment (service location analysis).

Attached: sample-invoice-chile.pdf (example invoice fields), redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.docx (vendor info + bank form)

Next steps:
- María: please prepare the two invoice variants (with/without IVA) and return with your bank details and whether you want USD or CLP.
- Rafael: once María sends the draft invoice, I’ll run it by Tax and AP and confirm final PO number/format.

We’ll aim to get the PO issued within two business days after we confirm the invoice format.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
